balls.text: finally he attempts the yorker!! This lands bang on middle, and Pandya whips it to deep midwicket after losing his balance a bit
wide again. Gill looks a bit frustrated. On the fuller side, but wide of off. Pandya lets it go

not off the middle of the bat, but still a six. On the fuller side of a length from Coetzee, who bowled this slightly wide of off. Pandya went through the line by opening the face of the bat a bit, but the ball still went over long-off
another wide. This is on the shorter side of a length, but very far from off stump. Again Pandya isn't bothered

another bouncer, and called wide. This pitched on middle, and Pandya swayed out of the way after looking to have a hook. GT review, though - because, why not? Pandya is clearly seen to be letting the ball go, although he seems slightly crouched. So it remains a wide

six more!! This lands ten rows over deep square leg. Another short delivery, but the line isn't very good this time. The ball arrives just outside off, and Pandya hammers this pull over the boundary by getting his front leg out of the way
another slower ball, and this is short and wide of off. Swatted to extra cover for another dot

the ball goes up a few miles in the air!! It then lands bang behind the sightscreen. Coetzee followed a bouncer with a full ball, but ended up bowling in the slot. The line was around middle, and Pandya simply presented the full face of the bat to launch it for six
a slower bouncer to begin with. Coetzee bangs this in on off, and the ball zooms up to finish over middle. Pandya has a swat-pull, but is beaten

half an appeal for caught behind by Mendis, but not given. Short in length, and on the stumps from Prasidh, who angled this in from around the wicket. Santner went across and looked to pull, but missed. I think the ball must have brushed his pad on the way to the keeper
slower ball again, as he goes full and wide of off at just 96kph. Santner looked to slash, but the ball rolled through to the keeper

good catch by Rashid! He was at deep midwicket, and he moved and slid to his right while completing the catch. Another slower delivery from Prasidh, but this is slightly fuller than the previous ball, and on off. Dhir looked to repeat the powerful whip from last ball, but ended up playing this in front of square
strong wrists, and bam! On a full length on middle, and he stays deep and low, before launching at this slower ball for six over deep square leg
on a length just outside off. Pandya went too hard with his attempted slog, but ended up bottom-edging to cover
on a few bounces to the man at deep midwicket, as Prasidh bowls pretty full on off. Whipped aerially by Dhir
good work by Gill at mid-off, as he slides to his left to keep this down to a single. Full and straight from Siraj, as Dhir backed away to drive

wow, what was that?! The no-look upper cut to deep third? Maybe. He jabbed his at this short delivery outside off, but then withdrew it, all while looking down at the pitch. The ball on a few bounces to Sai Kishore at deep third
on a length, as the ball angles into off. Pushed down to long-on
shorter side of a length on the stumps. He looked to clip but was hit high on his front leg on leg stump
bouncer on off, and finishes outside leg. Dhir looked to hook but left it alone. Wide called

gone?! Yup, the umpire at the bowler's end gives it out only after looking at his colleague at square leg. And guess what, Mendis finally hangs on to one. Siraj bowled on a short length on the stumps, but with a scrambled seam. The ball bounced well off the surface, although came on much slower than Tilak expected. He was across the stumps pretty early, and still went ahead with the attempted scoop. But he ended up gloving it to Mendis behind
hoicked over midwicket! Short of a length on middle and off, and Tilak had a free pull at this ball from just outside off. A very confident-looking shot
a high-ish full, and wide of off. Slashed to long-off
a bouncer on middle, and hooked to fine leg

taken at midwicket!! Rohit misses out on a hundred. Slower ball from Prasidh, who bowled this barely at 96kph. He bowled it on a length, and on off. The ball hardly came on towards Rohit, who was entirely beaten by the lack of pace there. He went swiping at it across the line, and ended up ballooning it for Rashid, who was at midwicket, and went a few steps back to take it
four more, although these are extras. The ball angled in, and hit the base of Rohit's pad as the latter looked to flick but missed. Mendis dived to his left, but couldn't get a hand
short in length, but this is pretty wide of off. Slapped on the bounce to point, as he looked to slash

into the MI dugout!! Hardik there shaped to have a swat at the arriving ball, but missed. Tilak went across the stumps early, and swivelled to have a pull at this short ball outside off for a six over fine leg
gets across the stumps, and Coetzee goes on a yorker length around seventh stump. Squeezed out to long-on by Tilak
flings the ball over the long-off boundary! Just reaches out for this length ball wide of off, and hits through the line while using the pace on the ball for a six
on a length, and wide-ish of off. Punched to mid-off
just short of Mendis! He went forward to try and take, but couldn't. The ball was a slower one, and on the shorter side outside leg. Rohit made room, and ended up ticking it behind
whipped over fine leg!! Effortless shot. He stays deep in the crease, and gets the perfect length - one in the slot on off - and has a heave across the line for six more
angling across, and on the fuller side of a length outside off. Driven just wide of mid-off for a single
on a length, and around sixth stump. It turns away, and is punched to extra cover
swept away over deep-backward square leg! This full ball dips on middle, and Rohit gets his front leg out of the way to have a swing at it for another six
on a length, and wide of off. Whipped to deep midwicket
slower, and on a fullish length on off. It turns in again, and is clipped to deep square leg
fullish and slower on middle, as Tilak gets across a little before clipping late to short fine leg's right
short in length, and just outside off. The ball turns in a bit, and is pulled to deep square leg
a low full toss on off, and nudged to long-on
slapped to deep-backward point! Quicker from Washington, who went on a length, and wide of off. The ball skidded through, and Rohit played hard at it
Rohit shapes to get across the stumps, and Washington bowls full and wide of off. Eventually driven to extra cover
on a fullish length on leg, and clipped to fine leg to get off the mark
this keeps low! On a length again, but this is around sixth stump. Rohit looked to slash, but the ball took the bottom edge to go behind square
on a length, and just outside off. Punched back to Washington

taken at fine leg!! Finally GT hang on. Washington there moved to his left, and went a little across, before the ball landed into his lap. RSK tossed this one up at Surya, who took a good stride out and ended up receiving the ball as a low full toss on off. He went ahead with the sweep, and ended up hitting the ball off the higher side of the bat
yorker on off, and jammed down to long-off
this dips on a fullish length on off, and straightens. Slapped to extra cover
deposited down the ground! He skips down the pitch, and gets to the pitch of this length delivery angled into middle. It was slower, too, but Surya read the change of pace, before lofting back
a low full toss, angled in and darted into middle. He has a flick, but ends up toe-ending it
slow in place, and on a length on off. The ball turns away, and is clipped towards midwicket
on a length on middle and off, and nudged to square leg for a hurried single
short in length, and just outside off. Punched towards point

dropped by Mendis again!! He tumbled to his right with both hands stretched out, but the ball didn't stick. The ball was on a length just outside off, and straightened after pitching. Surya had a jab but got an outside edge
slashed over backward point! Shorter side of a length, and wide of off. Surya has the room to have a liberal swing of the bat, and sends it flaying for a flat six
hooked over a straightish fine leg! Typical Surya, where he goes behind square. He is deep in the crease, and swivels while shifting his weight back to attack at this short ball just outside off
shorter side of a length, and just about on off. Punched to point
Surya takes a good stride forward, and sweeps this full and flat ball just outside off to fine leg
on a length and wide of off. Turns in, and is flashed to short third

bottom edge, and past the stumps! Full and straight from Rashid, as this ball turned in and finished just outside leg. Surya looked to sweep, but swung his bat too early. The ball just beat the leg stump
ohh, beaten! Slower from Rashid, and on a length around sixth stump. The ball straightens after pitching, as Surya looked to slash but missed
on the shorter side of a length on middle and leg, and clipped to fine leg
full and a little wide of off, and swept to midwicket with his bottom hand off the bat
That's a superb shot. Stifle short on middle and leg, he stays back and pulls in between deep midwicket and long-on
Length outside off, he pushes to deep cover

Just beats Prasidh who was running back from short fine leg. Should he have done better? Maybe. But it was always going away from the fielder. Tossed up outside off, he sweeps, gets a top-edge as the ball goes straight up. But Prasidh can't reach it
Fuller and on middle and leg, he whips this to long-on
Slows the length ball just around off, he eases this to deep cover
In the gap for four and that's fifty for Rohit in just 28 balls. Dragged down on middle and leg, he pulls in the gap to the left of deep square leg. A fine innings so far
Missing leg. Flatter on leg stump, he misses the flick and is hit on the pad. He was struck outside leg though
Flatter back of a length ball just outside off, he pushes this to long-on
THUMPED! Darted outside off, he brings out the sweep and deposits this with authority over deep backward square leg. Rohit completes 7000 IPL runs and 300 IPL sixes with that shot
Flatter length ball outside off, he taps this to the right of slip
Lofts inside-out over extra cover and gets four. Fullish in length just outside off, he gets a clean connection to the left of long-off
Flatter on a length on off stump, ticked to the on-side
Dragged down around off, he pulls to deep midwicket
Brings out the sweep and that is some stellar fielding from Tewatia who saves two. Tossed up outside off, he gets it to the left of deep backward square leg
Flatter on the stumps, he works this to the on-side for a run
Flatter on off, he pushes this to the right of Sai Sudharsan at short extra cover. Some miscommunication but they make it

A relay catch and GT have their first wicket... finally! Oh, that's a superb effort from Sai Sudharsan. The catch will go in Coetzee's name but this was all Sai Sudharsan. Was a tossed up delivery on the stumps. Bairstow gets a decent chunk on the reverse sweep. Sai Sudharsan, at backward point leaps up to his left, parries this up goalkeeper style and Coetzee was present at short third to take the relay catch
Floated on middle stump, Bairstow brings out the reverse and lifts this over point. Deep cover hares to his left and saves two
Oh, he had to adjust his shot at the last minute. Slows this googly up on middle stump, Rohit was looking for a sweep and then has to adjust and defends meekly
Huge appeal for lbw... was that pad first? Gill was at slip and says, nope it was bat. Flatter wrong'un on off stump, Rohit brings his bat down just in time
Gives himself room as Rashid pushes this fuller just outside off, YBJ drives to deep cover
Flatter googly on middle and leg at 97kph, he works this to deep midwicket
Too straight and is lucky to get away. Was a googly down leg, catches a Bairstow's pad to short fine leg
Shortish in length outside off, he looks for a cut but that was too close for that shot
Three sweeps in the over, three boundaries Rohit gets. MI have clobbered 79 in the powerplay. WOWZA! Floated just around off stump, Rohit sweeps and this time gets it well behind square
Jumps down the track but Sai Kishore pulls back his length as Rohit misses this flick. Gets rapped on the pad. There is a stifle appeal from the bowler, to no avail
Another sweep, one-bounce for four, now. Floated outside off, he bends down on one knee and slams the sweep to the deep square fence
Sails into the crowd and this is now MI's best powerplay this season. Three balls to go still. Angled in on middle and leg, he nails the sweep over deep square leg
backs away but Sai Kishore shortens this length on off as Rohit cuts to covers
Flatter on the stumps, he pushes this back to the bowler
Good fielding from Tewatia at backward point. Saves a four. Short and wide, he slams the cut to the right of the fielder who dives to this right
Clears mid-off and that's another boundary. GT are bleeding. On a length outside off, he lifts this over Coetzee who leaps, one-handed but can't reach it
On a length around off stump, he looks to blast this away to deep midwicket, gets a thick inside-edge onto pad and pinch in a quick run
FOUR more! Back of a length ball around off stump, he pulls this over short midwicket. That hit the higher part of the blade but that ain't bothering YJB
Big swing and a miss! Wobble seam length ball just outside off, he looks to send this to Chandigarh with a wild hack across the line. Does not connect.
In a length just outside off, he pushes towards cover-point and sets off

Gives room, gets an edge, gets four. It's all going MI's way and that over has gone for 26! Full shaping away outside off. Bairstow gives himself room, squeezes this out and gets a bottom-edge that flies past the keeper
The best of the lot! Right in the slot outside off stump, Bairstow stays legside of the ball and pumps this straight over the bowler's head

Edged FOR SIX! Wow, the bats these days. Fuller in length just around off stump. He looks to slog this away across the line, gets a thick outside edge that goes over short third. Such is the power and the bat swing that the ball goes over the ropes.
Beaten! Full and outside off stump. Bairstow does not move his feet much and looks for a drive. Can only connect at thin air.
And whacks this from the fielder had come in. Backs away to the short of a length ball outside off and cuts this up and over point
PULLED away for a gigantic six. Banged in short hip-high on the stump, he gets across and pulls this for a 95m six over deep square leg
On a length outside off stump, he steps across and heaves this to deep backward square leg
On a length on the stumps, he pushes to long-on

Edged and put down again! Oh, my word... GT what are you doing? A second reprieve for Rohit and Siraj is besides himself. Good length outside off, he jumps down the track, gives himself room and looks for a wild swing across the line. Gets a healthy edge that flies to the right of Mendis, who can't hold on. Was a fairly regulation chance

Huge appeal from Siraj, the umpire stays unmoved. No review from GT as well. Was a length ball veering into the batter, who misses the flick and is caught on the pad. But that was sliding past leg stump
HEAVED away! Back of a length ball outside off, he gets his front leg out of the way and deposits this over mid-on. Not out of the middle of the bat, but enough power to get four.
Back past the bowler and Rohit gets his first four of the night. On a length around off stump, he presents the full face of the bat and drives on the up past mid-off
back of a length ball on the stumps, he works this to deep square leg and calls for two immediately

Goes straight up, Coetzee gets around... and spills it. Oh, dear! Back of a length ball hip-high on off stump. Rohit pulls, gets a big top edge with the ball ballooning miles up. Coetzee sprints to his right from deep backward square leg, settles under it but fails to hang on
Sharp on-pace length ball on leg stump, he as looking to work it away, gets hit on the thigh pad with the ball rolling to the offside
Banged in short around rib high, he pulls behind square for a couple of runs
Poor line and Coetzee foes so well to save two. Good length ball on leg stump, he misses the clip, but the ball flicks his pad and goes fine. Coetzee covers excellent ground and dives full-length
Attacks him straight away. On a length well outside off stump, he slices this over point. Deep third can't get across
On a length on leg stump, he was looking to turn that fine, misses and gets rapped on the thigh pad
Juuust beats Gill at extra cover. On a length shaping away from Rohit outside off. He was looking to go up and over covers, miscues it and the ball just evades Gill
Full and on off stump, he watches this carefully and defends back to the bowler
Fuller outside off, he pushes to mid-off's left for a run
Short and wide from Siraj, he cuts this hard to the right of Shahrukh at cover-point who dives, gets a hand to it and saves two
A misfield to start the game from Sai Sudharsan and MI are away. Fuller shaping away from Rohit outside off, he steps forward and drives to Sai Sudharsan at extra cover who dives over the ball

appeal for lbw, but turned down. It was heading down the leg side, anyway. But with nothing to lose, MI review. Length ball pitching outside leg, as Rashid looked to heave but missed. He was hit on his thigh on the back leg, and there's no bat involved. Ball tracking shows ball pitching outside leg. So MI win by 20 runs, and GT are eliminated
yorker again!! MI are nailing them one after the other. The ball angles across, and arrives on seventh stump. Rashid has a flash, but is beaten

sliced to extra cover! Suraya there went low to his left to grab this. Ashwani bowled this quite full, and around off. Shahrukh went chipping, and ended up mistiming, with the length being too full for that shot. MI two balls away from victory
yorker slightly wide of off, and sliced away to deep-backward point. Superb work by the man at deep cover, who ran and dived to his left to save two
length delivery again, but this is wide of off. Shahrukh throws his bat at it to have a slash, but ends up bottom-edging back towards Gleeson
on a length on the stumps, and he hoicks across the line to deep square leg. That went off the inside half of the bat
into the second tier!! A length delivery on leg, and Shahrukh muscles this over deep-backward square leg giving it all his might
sweeps this low full toss on the stumps to fine leg. Bumrah at fine leg tumbles to his right to keep this to a single
superb execution! Yet another yorker, as this comes on middle and off. Shahrukh opens the face of the bat for a single to cover
another near yorker on middle, as he goes swiping. He gets an inside edge, though, and the ball trickles towards square leg
a knee-height full toss angling across, and coming on the stumps. Pushed towards cover, and they get two

gone!! Taken at deep midwicket! This is drifting away from GT. Tilak, placed at the boundary, came in a good few steps forward to take this. Boult bowled this right in the slot, and on middle. I think the ball kept a little lower than what Rutherford expected, and he missed his attempted slog even as the length was there to be hit. The ball went off the bottom of the bat
another yorker, as the ball angles away to come on middle and leg. Driven to mid-off for a single
full and just outside leg. He looks to sweep, but is hit on the side of his pad. The ball rolls to fine leg
again Tewatia makes room, but this time he misses. Bumrah goes for a wide yorker outside leg, and Tewatia is beaten on his attempted flick
swiped over midwicket!! Remember Tewatia?? He backs away, and Bumrah follows. But the ball comes as a low full toss outside leg, and Tewatia swings through the line for six
nearly another yorker, and just outside off. He manages to jam it wide of mid-off, and they push for a single. There's no throw at the non-striker's end, though
a low full toss angling across to come on off. Driven to extra cover, and he starts with a dot
has a swipe, but is hit on his front pad. The ball was heading down the leg side, though. Full ball from Ashwani, and angling in while pitching on middle
launched over extra cover! This time Tewatia decides to skip down the wicket, and slashes this low full toss arriving just outside off
yorker length on middle and off, and driven to extra cover. Very tight lengths here from Ashwani, as GT fall further behind with every ball
an attempted yorker on middle, and driven down the ground to long-on's right
a low full just outside off, and swept away to deep square leg between the man at deep midwicket and fine leg
just outside leg, and wide given. Angled in, and nearly a yorker. Tewatia looked to swipe but missed
full, and a bit wide of off. He drives to extra cover while leaning into the shot
outside edge, and four wide of the keeper! He went driving at this full toss angling across, and arriving on sixth stump. But the pace on the ball went it rushed away just wide of Bairstow for four
good yorker-length ball on off or thereabouts. Tewatia can only squeeze it out to mid-off

gone!! SS is knocked over. MI can breathe again. The GT fans are left shocked, as if wondering "now what?" The scoop shot has worked so well for SS this season, but this time he misses, the ball ends up hitting the base of the middle stump. Gleeson angled it across, and went for a yorker. SS spotted that fine leg was inside the circle, and went scooping. Not this time, though
on the bounce to deep point. He opens the face of the bat, and lofts this very full ball coming on just outside off. Tilak, who received the ball, seemed to be surprised by the force of the shot
in the gap between fine leg and deep square leg!! He whips hard, and aerially, as this ball comes full and on his pads. The perfect placement gives him four more
excellently pierced the gap!! Gleeson angles this across to bowl the yorker just outside off, and Rutherford opens the face of the bat to beat the man diving to his right at point
full again, and just outside off. This time long-off is back, and it's only a single
that looked so good!! He leans into this loft over mid-off, as this full ball arrives on off, and plays with a high right elbow and the full face of the bat

a full toss again, and again this comes on just above his front knee. He goes hard for a swipe, but is hit on his thigh, as the ball dribbles away. But it's given as a run, so there must have been an inside edge
a full toss around his knee, and angling in to arrive on leg. Clipped aerially to fine leg, as Ashwani gets away with that
very full on middle and off again, and driven hard to long-on. GT need boundaries rather quickly now
on a full length on middle and off, and pushed down to long-on
this is a slower ball, even as it is another low full toss on middle and leg. Pushed to long-on for a single
another yorker lands on target, as the ball arrives as a very low full toss on off. Pushed forward towards short extra cover

bowled him!! Washington is left down on the pitch, lying on his stomach. Another yorker, as the ball was angling across. This one was fired at 143kph, and landed on leg. Washington had opened his stance up, and ended up missing the ball as he looked to clip. The ball rushed through to beat the bottom of the bat, and clattered leg stump. Washington was left in no shape to play at that
angling across from over the wicket, and another yorker on off. Driven back towards mid-off
a yorker attempted, but this lands as a low full toss on middle. Clipped to deep midwicket
slower ball, and full and straight. Flicked to deep square leg, and Washington sends SS back after an attempted second

driven off a yorker length!! Mid-off tumbles to his left, but stands no chance of stopping it. Boult lands this on middle and leg, but Washington drills it back with his front leg out of the way. Rohit, in the dugout, is massively upset
and Boult now bowls a wide. He goes on a fullish length, and wide outside off. Washington shapes to smash, but lets it go
massive hit!! What a sound off the bat!! Boult is looking annoyed with himself. He bowls a length delivery on middle, and Washington dumps it over midwicket for back-to-back sixes
over fine leg! Short delivery from Boult, who bowled slow. The ball bounced nicely on middle, and Washington, after getting across, pulled confidently for six
lovely ball! Washington had got his front leg out of the way, and Boult fired a yorker bang on middle. Washington just brought his bat down on time
a slower ball, and short in length. It arrives on off, and is thumped to fine leg

SS looks to scoop, but is beaten. It is not given wide either... so SS reviews. Boult angled this in, and bowled it on a length on leg. SS was getting across the stumps to try and scoop, and finished outside off. The ball goes outside leg as he misses, and the third umpire says because SS had moved across, it is not a wide

driven to deep extra cover. Again a boundary off the last ball makes up for the lack of runs in the previous deliveries. The line was wide outside off, and the length there to be drive. So Washington reached out, and send it dribbling away for four
full, and around fifth stump. SS drives forward, but gets it off the inside half of the bat to long-on
on the fuller side of a length on off, and driven to long-off
it would have been a wide had he left this alone. Slower ball on a short of a length, and very wide of off. SS still reached out, and ended up mistiming a push to long-off
crisply driven wide of long-off, where Santner moves and tumbles to his right to keep this to two. Fullish ball outside off from Ashwani, as SS drove it along the ground through extra cover
shorter side of a length, and just outside off. Clipped towards midwicket, and again the batters push for two and make it

clears long-on! The fielder seemed to be in the game a for a second, but then realised it was going over his head. Pandya bowled a full toss yet again, although this arrived lower, and on the stumps. Washington went through the line in bashing it back down the ground to make up for the two dot balls
angled in, and this arrives on a yorker length outside leg. Washington was looking to swipe it away, but was hit on his toe outside leg
great comeback! He fires the yorker and lands it barely outside off. Washington has a slash, but misses
chipped over Pandya's head! Another full toss from Pandya, who bowled this angling into off. Washington lofted back with his front leg out of the way
a low full toss angling in to arrive just outside off. Swiped to long-on
sharp running! Shorter side of a length on middle from Pandya, and SS nudges it towards midwicket. He picked up two despite playing this off the back foot
Banged in short outside off, he arches away from that and lets it go
On a length on leg stump, he works this to deep square leg
Fuller outside off, he slices this past point but Tilak covers decent ground to his right from deep backward square leg
Just wide of Bairstow. Back of a length ball down leg, he pulls, the ball hits the splice of his bat and Bairstow can't reach it even with a full-length dive to his right
Full angling across the batter outside off, he punches to deep cover

How's Bumrah managed to save the boundary there? Or has he? The third umpire is having a look. Nope, that's four. Full on the stumps, he gets across and scoops this right over the keeper's head. Bumrah hares to his right from deep third and tries to keep the ball inside the field of play. Can't
Almost through him. Fuller in length just on off, he digs this out towards point
On pace length ball at 131kph on middle and leg, he eases this to long-on for a run
Fuller on leg stump, he flicks this neatly all along the ground to deep midwicket
Fullish in length on middle and leg, he pushes this to long-on for a run
IMPERIOUS! Good length ball angling across Washy who stands tall and punches this to the right of mid-off
Short of a good length ball on middle, he heaves this wide of long-on for a couple of runs
Length ball down leg that he flicks to deep midwicket
Tossed up on the fuller side outside off, he creams a drive to the right of long-off where Surya does well with a dive
SHOT! Angled in on off stump, he rocks back and whips this to the left of long-on
On a length outside off, he stays back and punches to the right of long-off for a couple of runs
Backs away to the length ball outside off, he slaps this to long-off
Stifle short and wide, he cuts this hard to Santner at backward point
Wayward delivery and Sai Sudharsan gets his fifty off just 28 balls. Full and down leg, almost a free-hit that is swept past short fine leg
He's deposited that in the gap. Marginally short on middle, he is quickly back and whips this in the gap between deep midwicket and deep square leg
Just a tad short on middle and leg, worked to deep square leg
tossed up outside off, he pushes back to the bowler

Oh, dear, he's trod onto his stumps! Wow, that's really unfortunate. On a length on off stump, he is right back as he looks for a pull. In doing so, his backfoot slips and the stumps are disturbed. That's a lucky break for MI, one which they desperately needed
Dragged down first up outside off, he rocks back and pulls to deep midwicket

A yes and no situation, and Mendis was not even in the frame had that hit. Slower offcutter on a length on off, he works this to square leg. Bawa has all the time in the world to hit. Misses and by a fair distance
Slower length ball on middle stump, he works this to the right of deep backward square leg for a couple of runs
Top edge but there is no one deep on the leg side. Banged in short  outside off, he gets enough bat on the pull to get four more
On a length on leg stump, he backs away but is cramped for room. Ticks this to midwicket
Good length ball just outside off, he punches this to cover-point
Sumptuous! He was beaten by the slower ball but still managed to adjust and send this away. Slower offcutter outside off, was a full toss that he whips this through midwicket
Ramped over the keeper's head. Banged in short outside off, he stands tall and gets it fine. Nothing that the keeper could have done there
Back of a length ball angling across the batter, he pushes off the toe-end of the bat to mid-off
Two in two! Short of a good length ball outside off, he stands tall and punches this through covers for another four. GT's fifty is up in 4.4 overs.
CRASHED! Short and just outside off, he gets on top of the square cut and thumps this past point
Slower offcutter that lands on a length outside off, he gets beaten looking to guide this fine
Slower length ball on middle, he works this to the right of midwicket
700 runs for Sai Sudharsan in IPL 2025 and he gets there in style. In the slot outside off, he prods forward, one knee bent, and creams a drive to the right of mid-off

Huge appeal for caught behind. The umpire stays unmoved but Bairstow is confident. Was almost a spontaneous appeal. And after all that, they don't take the review. Banged in short on middle, he arches back and looks to ramp this fine. Don't think he got anywhere close to that
Back of a length ball outside off, he opens the face of the bat and guides this fine to deep third
Back of a length ball down leg, he steps across and looks to scoop this fine. Can't connect but called a wide
Good length ball angling across Sai Sudharsan who runs this fine to deep third
Beats Boult in the deep. Banged in short around rib-high on middle. He pulls this and gets it to the right of deep backward square leg
Ooh, boy that's some pace. Starts off with the short of a length ball on middle. Sai Sudharsan has to arch back and YBJ leaps to collect this well over his head
That's gone into orbit! Two in two for Mendis. Length ball on Mendi's pad who picks this up cleanly for a 99m six over deep backward square leg. Twenty one off that Boult over.
Six more! Back of a length ball just outside off, he pulls this away right off the middle of the bat over deep midwicket
On a length shaping back into Sai Sudharsan just outside off, he opens the face of the blade and runs this down to deep third
Short and wide, he crashes this away to Dhir at cover-point who misfields and concedes two runs
First six of the GT innings. On a length down leg, no swing there. Sai Sudharsan whips this over deep backward square leg. Bumrah was interested for a second but this was well over him
On a length on off, he presents the full face of the bat to the right of Boult who stretches out his right hand and parries the ball to mid-off
Full and shaping away from Mendis outside off, he pushes this towards cover-point
Full in length shaping into Mendis just around off stump. He drives this back to the bowler
Fullish just around off stump, he squeezes this back towards the bowler, who parries to mid-on
Good length ball outside off, he cuts this to Tilak at point
That's a great stop from Bairstow. Full and well down leg. Bairstow dives to his right and saves a few extra runs
On a good length on his hips that Sai Sudharsan works this to deep backward square's right for a couple of runs
Angles the length ball across the batter outside off. Sai Sudharsan flirts with it and gets beaten
Sliced over point for a couple of runs. Full and angling across Mendis outside off, gets off the mark
Yorker just outside off, he digs this out

First-over Boult doing what he does best. This looks plumb but Gill has reviewed. He has to, doesn't he? Lands the ball on a length on off and middle and shapes this back in late. Gill goes for a whip across the line, misses and is trapped in front. No bat, on we go. And, yep, replays confirm the ball would have smashed into middle stump.
Splendid fielding by Tilak at mid-off. Wow, that's stunning. He's saved three. Too full outside off, he laces the drive and Tilak dives full-length to his right
Too straight on middle and leg as Gill picks this to deep backward square leg
On a length outside off, he stands tall and splits the gap between point and backward point.
